Select: canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name. Source: metabolism table. Join: compound_structures on substrate_record_id to get canonical_smiles; compound_records on substrate_record_id to get substrate_compound_name; compound_records on drug_record_id to get parent_compound_name. Filter: enzyme_name equals 'CYP2D6'. Sort: canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name ascending. Limit: 200.
